record_title: Square classes complete the order-two elementary involutions on M2(F)
provenance: A correction and completion of the order-two elementary graded-involution classification on M2(F), using the action on diagonal primitive idempotents, the monomial normalizer of the diagonal algebra, square classes, and scalar extension of graded identities and central polynomials.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Square-class classification of orthogonal involutions is standard background; the claim here is the explicit arbitrary-field completion/correction of arXiv:2609.20488v1 in its order-two elementary branch and the proof that the omitted forms are graded-*-PI and central-PI equivalent to the transpose representative. The Klein (-1)-grading and a complete arbitrary-field classification of all G-gradings on M2(F) are not addressed. Older discriminant or adjoint-form literature may contain equivalent structural language. No independent validation is asserted.
